content:
Long before the iPod, the Sony Walkman was the device of choice for anyone wanting to soundtrack their lives. Now there's a Duo-Man app that recreates that experience for those of us who owned a Walkman, and you can use it with Apple Music...

Before the Walkman, if you wanted to listen to music on the go, your options were very limited. Most cassette players at the time were bulky and not portable. Sony took a recorder originally designed for journalists and shrunk it down into the smallest cassette player of its era, instantly becoming a classic product.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created the app at a hackathon — since many people there had never seen an actual Walkman, he brought a real one along to show them what it looked like.

You open Duo, select the album you want to 'put in the cassette,' and close it to start playing.

Bhargava says he originally built it just as a fun demo app, but will now release it as a proper app. The best comment on the X post is this one — an image that only a certain age group will understand.

What was the first music player you ever owned? Feel free to share in the comments.
